get_shard_range: get the start and end indices for a shard given total items, number of shards, and rank
get_path_iterator: get an iterator over audio paths and sample counts from a TSV file split by shard rank
dump_feature: dump audio features extracted by a reader into an NPY append array file for a given shard
review_get_shard_range: review the get_shard_range function to verify shard index calculation logic for distributed processing
refactor_dump_feature: refactor the dump_feature function to support async feature extraction and writing
